check_occlusion: check if a target 3D point is occluded from a navmesh snap point using raycasting
snap_unoccluded_navmesh: snap a 3D position to the nearest unoccluded navigable point on the navmesh
snap_embodied_unoccluded_navmesh: snap a robot embodiment to a navmesh point considering collision and visibility constraints
check_navigability: check if robot navmesh offset points are navigable on a given navmesh island
check_path_navigable: simulate robot navigation along a path and check if collision rate is within threshold
